title: Produktmanager (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben
 Projektentwicklung von Gebäuden zur Wohnnutzung in der frühsten Phase zusammen mit internen Architekten/Planer-Kollegen
 Weiterentwicklung und Standardisierung unserer Modulbau-Produkte
 Analyse von Markt- und Kundenanforderungen sowie technischen Trend sowie Erkennen und Umsetzen von Kundenwünschen
 Auslotung von Fördermöglichkeiten für Projekten und deren bedarfsgerechte Beantragung und Implementierung
 Entwicklung neuer Produktkonzepte und technischer Lösungen
 Erste 3D-Gebäudeentwürfe als digitales Massenmodell aus dem vorentwickelten Modul-Baukastensystem
 Unterstützung bei der Kundenkommunikation – vom ersten Kennenlernen über die technische Konzeption bis zum Planungsvertragsabschluss
 Koordination von Produktänderungen und Optimierungsprojekten
 Erstellung und Pflege technischer Standards, Produktunterlagen und Spezifikationen
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Produktion, Einkauf und Projektmanagement
 Unterstützung bei der Einführung neuer Produkte und Technologien
 Mitwirkung an Kostenoptimierungen und Effizienzsteigerungen
 Begleitung von Innovations- und Entwicklungsprojekten
 Dein Profil
 Abgeschlossenes oder laufendes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Bauingenieurwesen, Architektur, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einer eine vergleichbare Qualifizierung mit Nähe zum Immobiliensektor
 Technisches Verständnis und Interesse an innovativen Produktlösungen
 Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen im Produktmanagement, Engineering oder der Produktentwicklung
 KI – Affinität und sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools und technischen Dokumentationen
 schnelle Entwicklung und Zeichnung von Gebäuden mit architektonischem Gespür
 Kenntnisse in der Software wie Revit, Sketchup oder ähnlichen 3D-Programmen
 Kenntnisse in den Bauprozessen, idealerweise Erfahrungen in der Architektur, Projektentwicklung, Planungs- /Baurecht oder der Erstellung von Neubauvorhaben
 Analytisches Denken und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
 Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
 Eigeninitiative, Kreativität und Lösungsorientierung
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
 Warum wir?
 Ein innovatives Unternehmen innerhalb eines internationalen Konzerns mit Entwicklungs- und Umsetzungsfreiräumen
 Eine unbefristete, anspruchsvolle sowie abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit
 Ein motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
 Modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz und digitale Prozesse
 Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
 Attraktive Vergütung und zusätzliche Benefits
 Ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Deine Ideen und Dein Beitrag zählen
 Sehen wir uns bald?
 Bereit, die Zukunft des Bauens mitzuentwickeln?
 Der Modulbau entwickelt sich rasant. Nachhaltigkeit, Digitalisierung und industrielle Fertigung verändern die Art des Bauens grundlegend. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel: Mit Deinem technischen Know-how und Deinem Blick für das große Ganze gestaltest Du Produkte, die den Anforderungen von morgen gerecht werden.Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.
 Werde Teil unseres Teams und bringe Innovation, Technik und Produktideen erfolgreich auf die Baustellen von morgen.
 Wenn du Fragen hast, wende dich bitte an einen unserer HR-Kollegen: Susann Ruf oder Thomas Olberts unter +49 3361 7693501.
Direkt bewerben

title: Technical Product Owner | Integrations (m/f/d)
description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops. 
 Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day .
 We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.
 We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.
 We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.
 In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.
 We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.
 This role is technical, but you won't be writing the code 
 You'll design API surfaces, debate OAuth and webhook patterns, and hold your own with senior engineers and external partner teams. The engineers write the code. Your job is to read it when needed, sketch API designs, argue technical trade-offs, and make sure what we ship is well architected. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility.
 Location & work mode 
 Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. We build better in the same room. Decisions happen faster, products ship faster, and the team stays sharper. EU work permit required.
 What you'll do 
 Own integrations, the public API, and webhooks end-to-end: strategy, spec, build, launch, measure
 Build the tools that turn our AI agents from clever responders into systems that close loops: agent to CRM, agent to appointment, agent to handover, agent to custom workflow
 Stay close to customers and partners every week, in direct calls, by talking to CS, sales, and BD, and by digging into the data yourself
 Embed with 4 to 6 engineers, set the metric, and own whether it moves
 Treat the public API and webhooks as a product, with proper DX, docs, and a real roadmap
 Make integration setup something a customer completes in minutes, alone, without a CSM walking them through it
 Own quality. Engineers test as they build, you give the final go before anything ships
 Own the launch and the awareness that follows. There is no product marketing team. You drive positioning, the in-product moments, and the keynote for the big launches, with marketing and sales behind you
 Work across squads with the AI and Core PMs on the surfaces that touch each other
 What we're looking for 
 5+ years experience in Product Management in B2B SaaS
 Background in Software Engineering
 A track record of shipping things people actually use
 Engineering background or strong hands-on coding experience
 Exceptional product and operational judgement
 Fluent in OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries, and API versioning. Tool-calling and function-calling patterns a strong plus
 Shameless customer obsession
 Extreme clarity in writing and thinking
 Speed without sloppiness
 Low ego and a builder's instinct
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and meaningful VSOP at a profitable, growing company
 Modern Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg
 Direct work with the founders and a real seat at the product table
 A team that ships fast and doesn't drown in process
 26 days of paid vacation, plus 2 extra days off for Christmas and New Year's Eve
 Annual personal development budget for conferences, courses, books, or coaching
 Regular team events, off-sites, and the kind of culture that makes you want to be in the office
 See how we ship 
 Every year we publish a Rewind: a public record of everything we built and shipped. Probably the easiest way to see what we've been up to.
 We firmly believe that diversity makes companies better. We welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to send us your application! 
 By submitting your application, you agree to our . 
 We look forward to your application!

title: Founders Associate - GTM
description:
Über Heidi Systems 
 Heidi Systems baut das Energy-OS für Real Estate. Dafür digitalisieren wir einen der letzten großen analogen Märkte Europas und schaffen die Infrastruktur für intelligentes Energiemanagement in Gebäuden.
 Wo wir stehen:
 Starke Pipeline mit +5.000 aktiven Deals
 Angel-Runde mit Unicorn-Foundern sowie Directors von Google und OpenAI
 Auf dem Weg zu 10x in 2026
 Wir rollen die Messdienstbranche neu auf – einen riesigen, verstaubten Markt, den seit Jahrzehnten kaum jemand angefasst hat. Als Prop- und ClimateTech verbinden wir Software, IoT und Operations zu einer Plattform, die Energie- und Verbrauchsdaten erstmals durchgängig digital, transparent und in Echtzeit verfügbar macht. So schaffen wir die Grundlage für eine intelligente und effiziente Energieinfrastruktur von Gebäuden.
 Wir wachsen stark und haben gerade unsere Angel-Runde erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Zu unseren Investoren gehören unter anderem Unicorn-Gründer sowie Directors von Google und OpenAI.
 Die Rolle 
 Als Founder's Associate GTM arbeitest du direkt mit unserem Gründer Paul zusammen. Gemeinsam baut ihr aus, wie Heidi Kunden gewinnt, betreut und hält.
 Du sitzt mit uns an einem Tisch und übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung. Dabei wechselst du zwischen Strategie und operativem Tagesgeschäft, treibst eigene Initiativen und bringst sie selbst ins Ziel.
 Du bist nah am Kunden. Was du in Gesprächen mit Hausverwaltern hörst, fließt direkt in Produkt, Pitch und Preise ein.
 Die Stelle passt für dich, wenn du gerade erst einsteigst und schnell lernen willst. Und genauso, wenn du schon ein paar Jahre Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Operations oder im Startup mitbringst. Je nach Erfahrung wächst die Verantwortung mit.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 GTM-Strategie: Du entwickelst mit Paul, welche Zielgruppen und Regionen wir angehen, wie wir uns positionieren und über welche Kanäle wir Kunden gewinnen.
 Markt und Wettbewerb: Du analysierst den Messdienstmarkt, Wettbewerber und Kundensegmente und machst daraus konkrete Entscheidungen.
 Vertrieb und Outreach: Du sprichst Hausverwaltungen, Wohnungsunternehmen und Bestandshalter an, führst erste Gespräche und baust mit uns den Outbound-Prozess auf, inklusive KI-Tools.
 Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust Kunden und deren Objekte, klärst Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass die Zusammenarbeit nach dem Abschluss rund läuft.
 Operations: Du findest heraus, wo Abläufe haken, und baust Prozesse und Tools, die das lösen. Zum Beispiel im CRM oder bei Übergaben zwischen Teams.
 Founder-Projekte: Du übernimmst wichtige und dringende strategische und operative Projekte. 
 Events: Du bist bei Verbandsveranstaltungen und Messen der Immobilienwirtschaft mit dabei.
 Das bringst du mit 
 Du denkst strukturiert, arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein und bringst Dinge ins Ziel, ohne dass dir jemand jeden Schritt vorgibt.
 Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu, auch am Telefon. Ein Nein wirft dich nicht aus der Bahn.
 Du hörst zu, stellst gute Fragen und erklärst Dinge so, dass ein Hausverwalter mit 400 Einheiten nach 2 Minuten weiß, warum er weiter zuhören sollte.
 Du magst es, wenn Zahlen zeigen, was funktioniert, und ziehst Konsequenzen daraus.
 Du kommst gut mit Tools klar, zum Beispiel CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Excel oder KI-Tools wie ChatGPT und Claude.
 Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, schriftlich und mündlich.
 Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Kundenkontakt, Operations oder einem Startup ist super. Quereinsteiger sind ausdrücklich willkommen.
 Benefits 
 Direkte Zusammenarbeit und tägliches Mentoring durch einen erfahrenen Gründer und eine extrem steile Lernkurve
 Teil eines stark wachsenden Early-Stage-Startups zu werden, das einen riesigen Markt digitalisiert – mit viel Eigenverantwortung, hoher Geschwindigkeit und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum
 Die Chance, echten Impact zu erzielen – an einem der größten, aber oft unterschätzten Hebel der Energiewende: Mit digitalen Messdienstleistungen schaffen wir die Grundlage für effizientere Gebäude und messbare CO₂-Einsparungen
 Bei sehr guter Performance besteht eine klare Übernahmeoption und die Möglichkeit, Heidi als einer der ersten 20 Mitarbeitenden langfristig mit aufzubauen
 Ein High-Performance-Team in einer humorvollen und unterstützenden Kultur, mit regelmäßigen Team-Dinnern und gemeinsamen Events
 Ein neu renoviertes Altbau-Office in Berlin Mitte direkt am Monbijoupark, gemeinsames Arbeiten an einem Tisch, kurze Wege und direkte Entscheidungen
 Zugang zu einem starken Netzwerk in Immobilien, Tech, Energie und Venture Capital

title: Project Manager
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.
As part of the Fever Originals team , you will leverage data, market insights, and strong commercial instincts to create one-of-a-kind events and experiences that enable people to enjoy unforgettable moments. Our goal is to develop and scale innovative experiences while building strong relationships with venues, partners, and industry stakeholders.
 Who You'll Work With
 You will join our office in Berlin, working closely with internal teams while directly engaging with partners, providers, and venues across the market.
In this role, you will play a key part in growing Fever’s pipeline of original events . A significant part of your work will involve identifying, developing, and negotiating partnerships with venues and external stakeholders, while collaborating cross-functionally with departments such as Marketing, Operations, and Finance to bring experiences to life.
The team you will join is young, ambitious, and highly collaborative, composed of top profiles from companies such as McKinsey, Amazon, Google, KKR, Cirque du Soleil, PSG, and Roland Garros. Team members bring diverse cultural backgrounds and share a strong entrepreneurial mindset.
 About the Role: 
 As a Project Manager, you will work closely with your Regional Lead to develop, launch, and manage Fever Originals experiences from concept to execution. The role combines project management, commercial development, and strategic partnerships, with a strong emphasis on venue negotiations, relationship management, and networking within the local entertainment and events ecosystem.
When you join Fever, you will receive training and coaching to help you:
 Identify and develop new business opportunities, including sourcing venues, partners, and collaborators for new event concepts
 Lead venue sourcing and contract negotiations, securing optimal terms and building long-term partnerships with strategic venues
 Ensure the financial and operational feasibility of our events by analyzing and reporting on key metrics
 Drive revenue growth by optimizing ticket sales strategies and identifying opportunities to expand event reach
 Analyze business performance, including P&L tracking, forecasting, and operational efficiency improvements
 Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, Legal, and Finance teams to ensure successful event launches and smooth operations
 Scale successful experiences across additional cities and markets by building replicable operational models
 Ensure high-quality experiences, maintaining strong standards for customer satisfaction and operational delivery
 About You: 
 We are looking for someone who combines a strong commercial mindset, relationship-building abilities, and analytical thinking, with a proactive approach to developing partnerships and growing the business.
 3+ years of experience in project management, operations, consulting, business development, partnerships, or similar roles (this role is not primarily suited for traditional event planners)
 German on a native level as well as fluency in English with excellent communication skills 
 Strong negotiation and networking skills, with the ability to build meaningful partnerships: you’re not afraid of picking up the phone and pitching to potential new partners
 Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and drive multiple workstreams to successful completion.
 Resilient and results-driven, able to perform under pressure, take ownership, and manage several high-impact projects in parallel.
 Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with venues, partners, brands, and stakeholders
 Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to use data to guide decision-making
 Highly solution-oriented, able to identify challenges and develop practical strategies to resolve them
 Ability to work and thrive in fast-paced environments and willingness to grow within the organization
 You will join a team of highly effective, motivated, and entrepreneurial professionals who move fast, take ownership, and get things done. Cultural fit means being humble, open to feedback, and willing to learn, while approaching challenges as opportunities and making decisions based on data and insight. We value individuals who are hands-on, collaborative, and able to prioritize what truly drives results. We encourage applicants from diverse and unconventional backgrounds, especially those who bring curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the drive to make a meaningful impact.
 Benefits & Perks: 
 Attractive compensation package and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance
 Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
 Competitive pension plan
 Work in the heart of the city, with possible travel across our markets

title: Senior Project Manager Size & Fit (all genders)
description:
BESTSECRET is the leading European online destination for premium and luxury off-price fashion. The Group offers its members in 28 countries across Europe a superior brand portfolio complemented by a high-end shopping experience. At the same time, BESTSECRET enables its brand partners to clear overstock at scale with minimum visibility and maximum brand equity protection. The unique business model is based on its closed character with an invitation-only customer membership, longstanding brand partner and customer relationships, combined with a tech-focused mindset.
 BESTSECRET has a strong track record of profitable growth over many years. It generated revenues of EUR 1,533.7 million in 2025 and employs around 2,200 people from over 90 nations. The Group draws on a heritage of 100 years in the textile and fashion industry and today is owned by Permira Funds and the founding families Schustermann and Borenstein.
 Your Mission 
 Help our members find the right size the first time. As Project Manager Size & Fit in our Content Management team, you will drive the projects that make size and fit information on BESTSECRET more accurate, more complete and more useful – across thousands of brands with very different sizing standards. Your clear goal: reduce size- and fit-related returns, improve customer experience and strengthen our profitability and sustainability.
 Your Responsibilities 
 Plan, coordinate and deliver Size & Fit projects from kick-off to roll-out – timelines, milestones, stakeholders and reporting.
 Analyse return behaviour and brand-level sizing data together with our Data & Analytics team to identify the biggest levers for return reduction.
 Improve the quality and coverage of fit notes, measurements, size charts, and model data on the product detail page, working closely with Content, Buying and brand partners.
 Steer the on-site implementation of Size & Fit projects with our current content service providers – e.g. determining product size tendency, rolling out processes, and ensuring continuous checks, validation and maintenance.
 Define and track KPIs such as size-related return rate, size-advice adoption and conversion, and prepare regular updates for management.
 Run test-and-learn initiatives (A/B tests, pilots on selected categories or brands) and translate the results into scalable standards and processes.
 Act as the interface between Content Management, Buying, Tech, Customer Service and Logistics on all Size & Fit topics.
 Document processes, guidelines and content standards and train internal & external teams on them.
 Your Profile 
 Degree in Business Administration, Fashion Management, E-Commerce, Textile/Clothing Technology or a comparable qualification.
 3+ years of professional experience in project management, e-commerce, content or returns management – ideally in fashion or online retail.
 Real interest in fashion, fit and sizing; experience with size charts, grading or fit processes is a plus.
 Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data (Excel/Google Sheets; SQL, Power BI are an advantage).
 Structured, hands-on way of working with a high level of ownership and the ability to manage several workstreams in parallel.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across business and tech teams.
 Willingness to travel within Europe to our content service providers' sites as required for on-site project implementation.
 Fluent in English; German is a plus.
 What Makes You Successful 
 Customer-centric mindset – you think from the member's fitting-room moment backwards.
 Pragmatic and solution-oriented, with an eye for detail where it matters.
 Comfortable with ambiguity and with building something new.
 Team player who enjoys working across departments.
 What We Offer 
 A high-visibility role with a direct, measurable impact on one of BESTSECRET's most important commercial and sustainability levers: the return rate.
 Ownership of the Size & Fit topic end-to-end – from data and content to customer-facing features – across a brand portfolio of several thousand premium and luxury brands.
 Close collaboration with Buying, Tech, Data and Customer Service in an international environment with colleagues from over 90 nations.
 Hybrid working model, modern office in Munich & Berlin and attractive employee discounts on our premium and luxury assortment.
 Long-term development opportunities within a growing Content Management & Convenience organization.
 At BESTSECRET, diversity isn't just a trend – it's our professional philosophy. We are dedicated to cultivating an inclusive workplace where everyone's unique talents and backgrounds are celebrated. Applicants from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are welcome to join us in our mission towards a more vibrant and inclusive future.

title: Product Manager, CMS (Remote)
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
Forbes Advisor is investing in the products and platform capabilities that power everything we build, and we're looking for a best-in-class Product Manager for our technology platforms team. This hands-on role will own products across our CMS platform, including reusable capabilities, partner propositions and platform features that enable our products across the business.
Great products are built on great platforms - so getting the foundations right is everything, whether that's for the teams using our products every day, the partners we build for, or the customers who ultimately benefit from them. You'll take products from discovery through delivery and continuous iteration, making sure what we build today can evolve with the business tomorrow.
Working closely with Publishing, Engineering, Design, Commercial and the wider Product team, you'll turn business needs into a clear, prioritised roadmap. You'll balance user needs, technical feasibility and commercial goals, keeping the people who use your products at the centre of every decision.
The person we're looking for is a genuine all-rounder who's equally comfortable working with engineers, internal teams and business stakeholders. You're naturally curious, enjoy solving complex operational problems, and are comfortable making smart trade-offs to deliver practical solutions. You're a self-starter and an exemplary communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned and reliably delivers what matters most.
 Responsibilities
 Strategy & roadmap 
 Develop and maintain product roadmaps for CMS capabilities, partner propositions and platform features, balancing user needs, technical feasibility and business priorities. 
 Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities, prioritise initiatives and continuously evolve the platform. 
 Product delivery 
 Lead product delivery from discovery through launch and ongoing iteration, ensuring products deliver measurable value. 
 Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria that Engineering teams can confidently deliver. 
 Own a prioritised backlog and work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design and QA to deliver high-quality products at pace. 
 CMS, Platform & Product Capabilities
 Deliver scalable CMS capabilities, reusable components and platform features that enable teams across the business. 
 Work closely with Engineering to design solutions that are reusable, maintainable and scalable as the platform evolves. 
 Collaborate with internal teams and third-party partners to deliver new partner propositions and enhance the platform capabilities that support them. 
 AI & continuous improvement 
 Use user feedback, operational insight and business priorities to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 Use AI, automation and reusable platform capabilities to improve internal workflows, reduce duplication and accelerate delivery. 
 Measure the impact of new capabilities and use those learnings to inform future product decisions. 
 Stakeholder communication 
 Build strong relationships across Publishing, Engineering, Commercial and the wider Product team, acting as the central point of communication for your product area. 
 Keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, delivery progress and product decisions. 
 What You'll Bring
 3+ years in product management, with a track record of delivering high-impact platform products, internal tools or business capabilities. 
 Comfortable working across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through delivery and iteration. 
 Experience with CMS, publishing tools, content platforms or partner-facing products is a plus. 
 Experience delivering cross-functional product initiatives, collaborating across Engineering, Design and business teams to achieve shared outcomes. 
 Comfortable working closely with Engineering and translating business needs into clear product requirements. 
 Experience using AI to improve product development, accelerate delivery and solve complex problems. 
 Data-informed, with strong product judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs that deliver the greatest value. 
 Exemplary communication and stakeholder skills, with a proven ability to build alignment across technical and non-technical teams. 
 Curious, pragmatic and proactive, with a practical approach to solving problems and delivering value. 
 Forbes Advisor provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Senior Product Manager - Trading Platform, Backend & Data (Europe, Remote)
description:
About GoCharting 
 GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading workflow platform with institutional-grade orderflow and DOM tools — footprint/cluster charts, volume/market profile, cumulative delta, imbalance charts, DOM trading. We are the only platform that delivers these capabilities fully on the web. Comparable to TradingView for general charting, but differentiated as the leader in the professional orderflow niche. PE-acquired and funded in 2025, profitable, 3M+ registered traders globally, with a mandate to scale 10x over 4 years. A US rebrand is underway and multi-asset coverage (US equities and options) is being added — the platform is entering its most important chapter, and the backend is where that growth is won or lost.
 The Role 
 This is a senior, hands-on product role at the core of how GoCharting works. The product's moat is technical — real-time market data, orderflow, and the systems that move it — and this role owns the part of the roadmap that makes that moat deeper. You will run backend and platform product work and own our third-party data integrations end-to-end: the exchange feeds, broker connections, and market-data vendors that everything traders see is built on.
 You are the product counterpart to a backend engineering team we are scaling right now — new senior engineers on the payments/billing platform, on market-data and broker connectivity, and on the core platform and SDK. Your job is to sequence and scope that work into a coherent roadmap, write the specs engineers build from, and hold the line on quality and reliability. You report to the Head of Product and partner daily with the CTO and his engineers, with Business Development (who sign the deals), and with QA and Support. This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, plenty of ownership.
 You move fast, write clearly, and make decisions with engineers, not over them. You are comfortable in the technical detail — APIs, data contracts, latency, schemas — without needing to be told what matters. In year one, success looks like a backend roadmap that ships, faster and more reliable data integrations, and a platform that stops being the thing users complain about.
 What you'll do 
 Own the backend & platform roadmap — market-data services, real-time pipelines, APIs, the SDK, and the systems behind charts, alerts, and trading — write clear specs and acceptance criteria, and partner with engineering from design through ship
 Own third-party data integrations end-to-end — exchange feeds, broker connections, and market-data vendors, from evaluation through onboarding to production — and build the playbook so the tenth integration is faster than the first
 Manage the provider relationship on the product side — scope, data quality, licensing constraints, SLAs, and the day-to-day of keeping feeds healthy (BD owns the commercial deal; you own the technical delivery)
 Make the trade-offs that matter — latency, reliability, cost, and coverage — and defend them with data
 Run dependency management — work across Product and Engineering so backend work is well understood, scoped, and scheduled to unblock other teams, sequenced against US expansion and ROI
 Treat quality and reliability as product features — define what "good" means, measure against it, triage data and platform issues with engineering, and close the loop with Support and power users
 What we're looking for 
 Must-haves: 
 6–9 years in product management , with real depth on backend, platform, API, or data-heavy products — you've owned infrastructure/data as a product, not just user-facing features
 Trading, investing, fintech, or financial-data background — you understand market data and the audience
 You are technical — comfortable with APIs, data models, schemas, and latency/reliability trade-offs, and able to hold your own in an engineering discussion (you read specs and schemas natively; you don't need to write production code)
 You have shipped third-party or data integrations end-to-end — evaluating providers, onboarding feeds, and owning data quality in production
 Strong written communication — you write specs and decisions engineers can build from without a meeting
 Sharp prioritization — you sequence ambiguous, interdependent work and make defensible trade-offs, and you say no
 Hands-on operator — you work with engineering, not through layers; you get into the detail and ship
